authority: GitHub owning issues; this file is a dated projection
scope: Builder Lab derived workflow products; existing wider revenue objectives are preserved
budget_authority: Proposed API-equivalent ceilings only; no cash-spend or unattended-run authorization

goals.title: Validate Builder Lab in two hosts and verify Dots eligibility
goals.owner_role: Academy steward; host maker and checker unassigned
goals.agent_state: Codex source handoff; Anthropic historical review; no live host worker verified
goals.measure: At least five positive and three negative cases per Codex/Claude host; record Dots eligibility and one bounded trial only if eligible
goals.rationale: Host reliability and source trust make the existing free lab useful and reusable
goals.next_gate: Machine-admitted final independent review, then actual host fixtures and Dots eligibility

acceptance.description: Offline scaffold/check/pack source and package evidence
Independent review of final exact source
Codex and Claude behavioral cases with missing/malicious evidence
Actual Dots eligibility and bounded connected-computer responsibility, or documented ineligibility

goals.title: Report per-goal usage, costs and unknown ROI from attributed receipts
goals.owner_role: Codex reporting maker; independent checker unassigned
goals.agent_state: Codex source handoff; independent source review and native run-receipt adoption pending
goals.measure: Report all six goals; reconcile both existing review receipts; reject duplicate usage and unsupported Done; show unknown lead usage and cash
goals.rationale: Measured cost and acceptance prevent money and tokens going to unsupported progress claims
goals.next_gate: Exact-source independent review and adoption of native run receipts

acceptance.description: Working offline JSON/Markdown report and sanitized CLI importer
Cache, missing cost, duplicates, refund period, zero investment and invalid completion regressions
Real maker run receipt and independently checked scoped report

goals.title: Capture twenty qualified buyer signals for one workflow offer
goals.agent_state: Candidate work only; no outreach or demand collection executed
goals.measure: Twenty unique qualified signals with role, reason and buyer-chosen price band; at least three permissioned workflow sample reactions
goals.rationale: Buyers reward solved tasks; free generic skill volume does not prove willingness to pay
goals.next_gate: Verified per-product consent-aware demand sink and owner-approved channel plan

acceptance.description: Actual demand endpoint and durable sink proof
Offer selection from evidence and price bands, with rejected alternatives recorded

goals.title: Produce one original paid workflow pack with cold-use evidence
goals.agent_state: Candidate product, no paid pack accepted
goals.measure: One original buyer-specific package; at least eight of ten cold-use tasks succeed; every unsafe fixture stops; complete sample and recovery guide
goals.rationale: Sell maintained domain outcomes and inspectable evidence built from existing technology
goals.next_gate: Buyer-evidenced offer selection, exact product repo/rights/owner and measured free baseline

acceptance.description: Original domain artifact and rights inventory in a verified owning repo
Eight of ten cold uses succeed, all unsafe cases stop, comparative baseline recorded
Complete sample, first run, troubleshooting, updates and uninstall/rollback

goals.title: Verify seller, licensing and external delivery lifecycle
goals.owner_role: Founder seller/legal owner plus commerce steward; agent implementer unassigned
goals.agent_state: No legal approval, merchant setup or live checkout inferred
goals.measure: One eligible external channel with verified seller/rights/terms/fees and sandbox purchase, duplicate event, refund/revocation and update proofs
goals.rationale: Use managed delivery and owned contracts to earn without creating hosted customer inference or custom support
goals.next_gate: Actual merchant/seller evidence and use-case rights/compliance review

acceptance.description: Reviewed seller, license/notices, terms, privacy and consumer duties
Native benefit lifecycle and duplicate/refund/update sandbox proof
Independent product release gate and approved actual fee model

goals.title: Reach ten buyers and EUR 1000 net receipts for the selected pack
goals.owner_role: Selected product sales steward; founder commercial approval required
goals.agent_state: Revenue target only; actual receipts and ROI unknown
goals.measure: At least ten distinct paid buyers and EUR 1000 receipts excluding VAT and refunds; reconcile contribution and acquisition/maintenance costs
goals.rationale: Fund continuation from attributable customer value and contribution, preserving wider revenue goals
goals.next_gate: Passed product release gate and owner-approved truthful sales assets

acceptance.description: Ten distinct paid buyers with anonymized merchant evidence
EUR 1000 net receipts in the dated product period
Reconciled cash contribution, refunds and investment before ROI claim
